cards.title: I want a new website

cards.title: I want to review my project

sections.title: What we review before recommending.
sections.lead: The initial review focuses on commercial information: offer, market, materials, and contact priority.

cards.title: Offer
cards.description: What you sell, how you explain it, and what questions appear before contact.

cards.title: Market
cards.description: Who you serve, in what area, and what they need to compare.

cards.title: Materials
cards.description: What photos, logos, copy, or examples already exist.

faq.title: Before messaging
faq.lead: What to expect from the first exchange.

items.title: Can I start with limited copy or photos?
items.content: Yes. We guide you to turn what you already know about your business into clear copy, useful sections, and well-presented starter materials.

items.title: Is the first contact through WhatsApp?
items.content: Yes. The first message opens a quick conversation to understand your business, your goal, and the kind of website that can serve you.

items.title: How do you help my business?
items.content: We turn your offer into a clear digital presence, with visible contact paths and initial data to make commercial decisions with more context.

items.title: What information should I prepare?
items.content: Services, service areas, differentiators, available photos, visual references, and how you prefer to receive customers.

items.title: Can you guide me if I am still defining my website?
items.content: Yes. We help you choose structure, plan, and messages so the first version has a clear commercial direction.

final.title: Start with the context you already have.
final.lead: If information is missing, we organize it in the conversation.
